notes.content:
Anshar Publishing Sale starts now on Steam! 
 It's a fantastic opportunity to check out other games from our Publisher, and get some really good deals 😏 Anshar Publishing's most popular games, such as Coridden, Gamedec and Zoria: Age of Shattering will be available at an all-time low prices, so make sure to check the Publisher Sale out! The offer ends on October 2.



Of course, the deals you can make are the best part. Besides regular discounts, you'll find some really amazing Bundles. But that's not all! Anshar Publishing encouraged friendly studios to create exciting bundles together, and we're sure everyone's going to find something they like 😊 
Upcoming Games - Add Them to your Wishlist!🧽 Moldwasher
Jump into Moldwasher and play as an adorable sushi armed with a power washer, ready to defend the kitchen from spreading mold! Blast away grime, discover hidden collectibles, and decorate your room with fun stickers as you make the house squeaky clean. Are you up for the challenge of keeping your home spotless and mold-free? The cleaning adventure awaits!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688130/Moldwasher"][/dynamiclink]
🎲 Sigilfarer
Lead a team of four unique heroes in Sigilfarer, a roguelite adventure that puts a fresh spin on deck-building games—here, you fight by rolling dice! Equip your heroes to shape their abilities as you journey through perilous, tainted lands protected by the power of a single sigil. Strategically manage your resources, adapt your tactics, and cleanse the world of corruption. Are you ready to roll the dice and guide your heroes to victory?

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2436870/Sigilfarer"][/dynamiclink]
Games That Are Out & Ready To Be Played!🤖 Bytebond - OUT NOW!
Looking for a fun way to connect with a friend? Bytebond is a light-hearted two-player game where teamwork and quick thinking are the keys to success! Jump into a colorful cyber world, solve puzzles, and tackle challenges together. It’s all about bonding, bytes, and having a blast—perfect for casual players who love a good co-op adventure! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond"][/dynamiclink]
🗡️ Whispers of the Eyeless
Step into the haunting world of Whispers of the Eyeless, where your choices shape the fate of a mysterious realm plagued by an ancient cult. Uncover dark secrets, face unseen horrors, and immerse yourself in a gripping narrative adventure. Will you survive the shadows and reveal the truth behind the Eyeless? The story is yours to decide.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2523890/Whispers_of_the_Eyeless"][/dynamiclink]
🐲 Coridden 
Become a shapeshifter and explore a vibrant open world teeming with monsters, mysteries and challenges, as you embark on an epic journey. Engage in action-packed combat and make strategic choices that shape your path. Team up with friends in cooperative gameplay to tackle formidable foes and uncover the secrets of your world together.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656930/Coridden"][/dynamiclink] 
⚔️ Zoria: Age of Shattering
Step into a rich, immersive world filled with magic, mystery, and adventure. Zoria: Age of Shattering is a tactical RPG that will test your strategic skills and keep you on the edge of your seat. Lead your party through challenging quests, uncover hidden secrets, and shape the fate of Zoria. Don’t miss out on this epic journey! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159090/Zoria_Age_of_Shattering"][/dynamiclink]
🕵️ Gamedec
Ever wanted to be a detective in a cyberpunk world? Gamedec lets you do just that! As a private investigator in a dystopian future, you’ll solve intricate cases in virtual worlds. Your choices matter, and every decision you make will shape the story. Get ready for a thrilling narrative experience that will keep you hooked from start to finish. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/917720/Gamedec__Definitive_Edition"][/dynamiclink]
🔥 Liberte
Immerse yourself in the dark and gripping world of Liberte, a roguelike deck-builder set during the French Revolution. With its unique blend of strategy and fast-paced action, Liberte offers a fresh take on historical events. Build your deck, face formidable foes, and change the course of history. Vive la révolution! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1590160/Liberte"][/dynamiclink]
🌿 Weakless
Embark on a heart-warming journey with Weakless, a puzzle-adventure game that tells the touching story of two unlikely heroes – a blind creature and a deaf creature. Together, they must navigate a beautifully crafted world, relying on each other’s strengths to overcome obstacles. It’s a tale of friendship, resilience, and the power of unity. 

  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072620/Weakless"][/dynamiclink]
🎭 The Last Show of Mr. Chardish
Experience the magic of theatre in The Last Show of Mr. Chardish. This narrative-driven adventure game takes you on a nostalgic journey through the life of a once-famous actor. Explore stunning hand-painted environments, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of Mr. Chardish’s past. It’s a heartfelt story that will leave a lasting impression. 

 [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1164060/The_Last_Show_of_Mr_Chardish"][/dynamiclink]

Embark on a thrilling space adventure in Detached. This immersive first-person experience places you in the vastness of space, where survival is your ultimate goal. Navigate through breathtaking cosmic environments, solve challenging puzzles, and engage in intense zero-gravity combat. With its realistic physics and captivating atmosphere, Detached offers a gripping journey that will test your skills and leave you in awe of the universe's wonders.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/848410/Detached_NonVR_Edition"][/dynamiclink]

Step into the fast-paced arena of Telefrag VR. This adrenaline-pumping virtual reality shooter transports you to a futuristic world where gladiatorial combat reigns supreme. Master the art of teleportation and outmaneuver your opponents in dynamic, arena-based battles. With its innovative mechanics and stunning visuals, Telefrag VR delivers an exhilarating experience that challenges your reflexes and strategic thinking. Prepare for a duel like no other, where victory is just a teleport away.

notes.title: A New Update for the VR version of Detached is here!
notes.content:
Big News from the Detached Universe! 🌌 

Attention, space explorers! We’re thrilled to share some exciting news from the Detached cosmos. While you’ve been navigating the zero-gravity challenges of the non-VR version, our sibling project—the original VR version of Detached—has just received a major update! 🎉

Detached VR was where it all began—a thrilling, immersive journey through the vastness of space, designed to make you feel like a true astronaut. And now, it’s better than ever! If you’ve enjoyed the non-VR version of Detached and have since added a VR headset to your setup, this is the perfect time to experience the game in its original, fully immersive form.

[previewyoutube=5t8MRGsebK8;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s what’s new in this update:

✨ Expanded Headset Compatibility
We’ve opened the airlocks to welcome more players aboard! Detached now supports a wider range of headsets, so even more space explorers can experience the thrill of navigating the cosmos.
👉 The game supports now Oculus Quest 2/3, Pico 4 Pro/Ultra, Valve Index, and HTC Vive.
Note: Windows Mixed Reality (WMR) is no longer supported due to compatibility issues with the latest Windows 10 and Windows 11 updates.

✨ Updated Default Control Scheme
Piloting your ship has never felt smoother. We’ve fine-tuned the controls to ensure they’re perfectly aligned with the capabilities of the latest headsets.
👉 Improved FXP control scheme for Oculus Quest 2/3, Valve Index, and Pico 4 Pro/Ultra. ​​

✨ Bug Fixes and Stability Improvements
We’ve patched up some cracks in the hull to ensure your journey through the void is as seamless as possible.
👉 Resolved a crash issue caused by OpenSSL 1.0.2 in Unreal Engine 4.19 on Intel 10th Gen+ processors. The game now uses the updated fix from Unreal Engine 4.22, ensuring smoother performance.

Detached VR was one of our very first projects, and it’s a game that’s incredibly close to our hearts. Revisiting it after all these years has been a nostalgic and rewarding journey for us, and we’re so excited to share this updated version with you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/436230/Detached/
─────────────────────────────────────────────
🎮 Follow Anshar Publishing on Steam 🎮

notes.title: Coridden is Out Now! 🎉
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that Coridden is now available! 🥳 
This colourful aRPG is a testament to the love for gaming and will be a treat to any fan of the genre.

See the Launch Trailer:
[previewyoutube=O_mnPa8t23A;full][/previewyoutube]

Coridden is an action RPG where you play as a monster-shifter, able to transform into the creatures you defeat. Venture out alone or in CO-OP with up to 3 friends on a journey to uncover the dark secrets sealed inside the legendary city of Aasha.

🦕 BECOME A SHIFTER - Switch between your human and beast form freely to utilize each form's strengths and skills when needed.

🏹 ACTION FOCUSED COMBAT - Experience intense combat action where both your own skill and character gear matters.

⚡️ GROW YOUR POWERS - Build up both your human and monster form with new gear, attributes, active and passive skills as you level up.

🦹‍♂️ 🦸‍♀️ RIDE OUT SOLO OR IN CO-OP - Up to 4 players can play together in drop in/drop out co-op gameplay, both locally and online. 

🏇🏻 HOP ON MY BACK - Ride on each other’s back to become a strong cavalry unit together!

🌺 EXPLORE THE WORLD OF HEERA - Jump, swim, use fire and break walls to access and explore everything from dangerous caves to old structures, in order to solve quests and find loot.

notes.title: Telefrag VR is available now! Let's get to fraggin'!
notes.content:
Gladiators, the wait is over!

Telefrag VR is now available on Steam Store, Oculus Store, and PlayStation Store. Make sure you have what it takes to become a space gladiator. Prepare your VR headset and one of the supported controllers (from Touch Controllers to 3dRudder and PS Aim (coming soon)!) In case if you still wondering, here's the new Telefrag VR Launch Trailer. Check it out! :) 

WATCH TELEFRAG VR LAUNCH TRAILER

https://youtu.be/_oqqPjjnvCo

Compete on 5 unique arenas: The Fallen Champion, The Mobius Villa, The Lazarus Grotto, The Imperial Shipyard and The Six Leagues Under. Each of them will give you a completely different experience, but above all, many challenges. We put in your hands a full arsenal of destruction, inspired by the legendary tools of extermination from the classic 90's FPS games: Particle Cannon, Laser Pistol, Plasma Rifle, Flak Cannon, Rocket Launcher. Pick the best loadouts, conquer the enemies, and finally make a name for yourself - The Champion.


TELEFRAG VR MAIN FEATURES

For those who are not following our news, here's the short brief, what are the core features of the game. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/7c157820a99999992c7e2e37891f38750a1d3ad2.jpg

Telefrag VR is set in an alternative universe where the Roman Empire never collapsed and instead consolidated its power on earth and continued to expand into outer space. The conquering of new systems and races, and development of new technologies ushered in a new era of gladiator battles. 

•	Loadout Management – Players have a chance to utilize different loadouts, each containing two weapons. Every weapon features two firing modes and a unique teleportation attack.

•	Teleport Attacks and Telefrags – Teleporting allows players’ contact weapons to inflict “Melee Damage” as they shift from one point of the arena to the next, adding an extra layer to the standard teleport mechanic used in VR.

•	Guns – Projectile weapons inflict “Ranged Damage” upon the target. The game features well-known classic arena shooter weapons.

•	Fast-Paced matches – You have two different locomotion types at your disposal. Get comfortable with dash movement or experience, why gladiatorial battles are reserved for the most persistent ones in the free locomotion.

•	Impossible Spaces – Walkable surfaces can be placed regardless of gravity, allowing the player to travel on any designated surface regardless of its rotation and position relative to the “real” floor. This enables multiple angles of attacks and passages through play space, and as a result a fresh take on competitive level design. 

•	Arena Game Mode – A 1v1 gameplay mode where the player enters an arena with 5 weapons ready to pick. Choose two of them to compose the best loadout.  We put in your hands (both hands actually) a full arsenal of destruction, inspired by the legendary tools of extermination from the classic 90's FPS games. 


NEED SUPPORT? WANNA PLAY? CONTACT US

https://i.imgur.com/4o111Ym.jpg

In case of any problems with the game, feel free to contact us, using Steam forum or our Discord channel. We'll try to investigate the incoming bug reports as soon as possible. Also, make sure that you're on the loop, 'cause our team is ready to rock with you on Telefrag VR arenas! You will find all the details on Discord.

In behalf of the whole Telefrag VR Team, we hope that Telefrag VR succesfully inject some classic arena shooters vibe to the virtual reality. Let's Get to Fraggin'! 

https://i.imgur.com/z32drG7.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/

notes.title: Introducing The Mobius Villa - Telefrag VR
notes.content:
THE MOBIUS VILLA

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/5ba1dc1c78a60fcf7590cf654b5db06002612442.png

Hi there,

Since we updated our Steam page, we would like to reveal more details about the next map from Telefrag VR. Ladies and gentleman, here's The Mobius Villa!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/2cb47c2f35273fe755fc8a3efcdc88bd4c5b86e5.png

"This place is the perfect reproduction of the ancient architecture of Rome. The traditional Roman Domus contains specific elements like peristyle, atrium or beautiful sculptures on every corner. But you haven't come here to watch, don't you? Better be ready and think about how you can dominate your enemies in PvP clashes..."

The villa is slightly different from The Fallen Champion, which construction was focused on the wide-open spaces. Here, we are dealing with a completely different picture of the futuristic Roman Empire - Calmness and prosperity can be seen at first glance. The scheme and stages of creating the map will indeed be shown to you on the occasion of the post-mortem, but in today's news, we will focus primarily on the most significant differences from the first map. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/a24cd63dd115d10b0df8cac4533967e307ab1ac0.png

The Mobius Villa is a narrow battlefield, with a mass of corridors and nooks where the enemy can lurk. The passage through the villa's main floor doesn't have to be packed with traps, because with the help of teleport guns and gates you can quickly change your location, using the minimum spaces between columns or given rooms. The underpassage is also worth checking thanks to easy accessibility. But you probably know the risks waiting for you, staying too long in the open area.
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/e168ba1c115d2ab62e165a69440edefeb3f9d0af.png

Teleport gates are also able to pull you out of a place that in theory seems to be a dead end. If the enemy has not left a trap for you on the other side of the portal - you can feel safe.

Below you can see a final shot from the map compared with the shots from the early and development stage.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/8c483b9a2de50da938f7384fe57848f7914236f8.png

---

Set in an alternative universe where the Roman Empire never collapsed, you step into the shoes of a new breed of a gladiator on the road to becoming a champion. Use your speed, accuracy, and wits to outmaneuver and defeat your enemies, crushing them beneath your feet.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/

notes.title: Detached: Non-VR Edition is now available
notes.content:
Enter Space Without VR

https://media.giphy.com/media/7YCzbXzWlIza7MiFwE/giphy.gif

Have you ever wondered what NASA’s requirements are for becoming an astronaut? They’re simple really. You need to have a bachelor’s degree in biology, physics, or math. Three years of experience in the field, or at least 1,000 hours of pilot-in-command time in a jet aircraft. Oh, and excellent vision, obviously. Now, we’re pretty sure neither the first or the second would be a problem for you, but this eagle eye thing… thaaat might be a tiny bit of a problem. Too many night hours spent playing video games had to take its toll on you eventually, eh?

https://i.imgur.com/pftEqDf.jpg

But don’t give up on your dreams just because your eyesight’s not as sharp as it used to be. Simply grab your copy of Detached, because now the game can be played without VR goggles!

Cross-Platform PvP battles

https://i.imgur.com/6xoW3PQ.png

Detached in the non-VR version contains a full single player campaign, thanks to which you will try to survive in an extremely difficult environment - a cosmic abyss where each of your movements must be countered. Master the possibilities of your suit and explore the abandoned space station.

From now on you can also fight in the PvP cross-platform mode, thanks to which you will fight with players who have not only the non-VR version, but also the version on Oculus Rift, HTC Vive and PS VR.

You are not sure if it is worth starting the battle in two multipurpose modes? Take advantage of the free demo that allows you to test both single player mode and fun in the Package Extraction mode.

So... let's have so fun in space! :) 

If you want to learn more about Detached game, visit the game website or follow us on Twitter or Facebook. Feel free to contact us!
